mechanism: Leflunomide inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, reducing folate metabolism and increasing homocysteine levels; folic acid supplementation helps mitigate leflunomide-induced folate depletion and associated toxicity.
action: Folic acid supplementation (5-10 mg daily) is recommended during leflunomide therapy to reduce gastrointestinal toxicity, bone marrow suppression, and hepatotoxicity risk.
